verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs list unattended access with a permanent password. That covers every element of the story: credentials configured in advance, and no one needed at the host to accept. A community daily user also references unattended-access use and welcomed the Wayland unattended fix, but the documentation is a single-line claim. Unattended access on Wayland and at the login screen is documented only in a separate x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu preview build. missing for 10: in-depth first-party setup documentation for configuring the permanent password, unattended/login-screen access on Wayland in standard builds, independent hands-on corroboration of the unattended setup flow.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set up unattended access to a machine with credentials configured in advance, so no one has to sit at the host to accept

citations.quote: unattended access with a permanent password
a separate x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu-based preview adds Wayland unattended access and login-screen access.
